name: Happy Route o Owarasete
original_name: ハッピールートを終わらせて
source:
I, the protagonist, Akabane Hyouga, have been able to see Choices since the past.

In these "Branches"...... If I were to choose the right options at these fate-changing moments, I could carve a way into a beautiful, happy future.
――So is what I wholeheartedly believed.

No, the original Choices (Routes) have been locked away by some god unknown force. Instead, only the direst, the inauspicious, the worst options, were provided to me. And such were all that was left to be chosen.

Player, the only one who can grant someone as powerless as me the strength to change everything, is you.

In order to restore the world into it's original state, Hyouga seeks assistance from the Player, to retain the original Choices.

――This is the story of a protagonist who reconstructs his routes, and his destiny.
translation:
我，主角赤羽冰河，从过去就能够看到选择。

在这些“树枝”里……如果我在这些命运改变的时刻做出正确的选择，我就能开辟出一条通往美好幸福的未来的路。
——我也是这么坚信的。

不，最初的选择（路线）已经被某种未知的神力封锁了。相反，只有最可怕、最不吉利、最糟糕​​的选择提供给我。这就是剩下的所有选择。

玩家，唯一能给我这样无能为力的人改变一切的力量的人，就是你。

为了让世界恢复到原来的状态，冰牙向玩家寻求帮助，以保留原来的选择。

——这是主人公重构自己的路线和命运的故事。
